title: Add physical-root to scripted-shell tracking evidence

observed_metric_invalidity.consequence: ZeroActions is rewarded for remaining statue-like while the kinematic actor shell travels the scripted route. The v1 standing-derived cost measures pose, tilt, and height but never verifies that the physical character follows the shell.

hypothesis: Actor-local baseline tracking will show that Normal moves the simulated pelvis/root with the shell while ZeroActions leaves it behind. This is the missing causal locomotion outcome required for a valid protocol-v2 comparison.
single_change: Evidence instrumentation only. Record simulated pelvis/root world position, cumulative physical-root planar path, net physical-root displacement, and planar error from the actor-transformed initial root offset. Add the same aggregate fields to scenario-summary.json. Do not change policy, Pose Search, gains, shell motion, timing, state transitions, or acceptance behavior.
tdd_contract: Tracking error is zero when the physical root equals actor_transform * initial_actor_local_root_offset.
Tracking error is invariant to actor translation and yaw when the relative offset is preserved.
A 5 cm planar physical-root displacement from the expected shell-relative location reports 5 cm error.
Every scripted physics row contains physical_root_location_xyz_cm, root_shell_tracking_error_cm, and physical_root_path_length_cm.
Scenario summary contains physical_root_path_length_cm, physical_root_net_planar_displacement_cm, final_root_shell_tracking_error_cm, and max_root_shell_tracking_error_cm.
Normal and ZeroActions retain identical scripted shell path, turn, and phase behavior.
next_if_supported: Use the measured discrimination to preregister immutable scripted-locomotion protocol v2 and its causal score before running any final bundle.
